latestWeddings.title: Latest weddings
latestWeddings.subtitle: The most recent weddings we've captured, fresh from the last few shoots.

albums.qrHint: Point your phone camera at the code, or copy the link below.

weddings.title: The day, kept exactly as it felt.
weddings.subtitle: Ceremonies and celebrations, photographed to show exactly what the day felt like to everyone in the room.
weddings.description: From the first look to the last dance, we document weddings with a storyteller's eye and a guest's warmth — wide establishing frames, the small details you spent months choosing, and the unguarded moments between them that you will want back years from now.

companies.title: Brand imagery with substance.
companies.subtitle: Corporate portraits, office culture and campaign work for teams who take their image seriously.
companies.description: We spend time inside your business before we shoot it — understanding the culture, the people and the story you want your brand to tell, then translating that into imagery built for websites, decks and campaigns alike.

restaurants.title: Food and atmosphere, in equal measure.
restaurants.subtitle: Menus, interiors and the quiet choreography of service — shot to make people hungry and curious.
restaurants.description: Plates are only half the story. We capture the steam off a fresh dish, the warmth of a dining room at golden hour, and the hands behind the counter — a complete visual language for menus, socials and press.

events.title: Moments as they actually happened.
events.subtitle: Conferences, launches and celebrations, documented discreetly from first arrival to last toast.
events.description: We move quietly through the room, anticipating the moments that matter — a handshake, a toast, a room mid-laugh — so the story of your event survives long after the night is over.

products.title: Every detail, considered.
products.subtitle: Studio and lifestyle product photography built for e-commerce, catalogues and campaigns.
products.description: Clean studio setups or styled lifestyle scenes — we light every product to show texture, form and craftsmanship, delivering catalogue-ready imagery that holds up at any size.

realEstate.title: Properties that photograph like homes.
realEstate.subtitle: Interiors, exteriors and aerial views composed to help buyers picture themselves inside.
realEstate.description: We photograph properties the way a buyer walks through them — light-filled, spacious and true to scale — combining interior detail with wide architectural frames and aerial context.

drone.title: A perspective only altitude can give.
drone.subtitle: Aerial photography and video for landscapes, real estate and large-scale events.
drone.description: Licensed aerial coverage that reveals scale and geography impossible from the ground — coastlines, estates, construction progress and events, captured in smooth, cinematic passes.

cinematicVideo.title: Motion with the same restraint as our stills.
cinematicVideo.subtitle: Short films, brand documentaries and cinematic reels shot on a filmic, patient palette.
cinematicVideo.description: The same eye for light and composition that defines our photography, extended into motion — deliberate pacing, natural sound and colour work that favours mood over spectacle.

about.label: About me
about.title: We don't just take photographs.
about.body: A professional photographer based in the Eastern Province, with a deep passion for documenting beautiful moments and creating refined visual content that touches emotions and preserves meaningful memories.
about.body2: For over a decade, Yahya Al-Saib has photographed weddings, campaigns and spaces across three continents, always with the same conviction: photography is not documentation, it is memory made permanent.

projects.label: Featured Projects
projects.title: Selected works
projects.subtitle: Three stories from the archive — each one a different discipline, the same obsession with light.

atlas.title: Whispers of the Atlas
atlas.description: A wedding story told across the high desert — wind, silk and golden light at the edge of the mountains.

concrete.title: Concrete Poetry
concrete.description: Brutalist geometry softened by morning fog, human scale and the patience of long exposures.

marrakech.title: Midnight in Marrakech
marrakech.description: A nocturnal fashion series wandering the lantern-lit medina, shot entirely on available light.

story.label: Featured Story
story.title: The Silent Coast
story.intro: One commission, three mornings, no words.

one.title: Before the light
one.text: We arrived in darkness. The sea was a sound, not a sight, and the cliffs held their breath.

two.title: The first frame
two.text: At 6:42 the fog lifted for ninety seconds. Everything the project needed happened inside them.

three.title: What remains
three.text: Twelve photographs survived the edit. The client hung one. We kept the silence.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.text: A conversation about what the images must do, and for whom.

planning.title: Planning
planning.text: Locations, light studies, moodboards and a shot list we intend to break.

photoshoot.title: Photoshoot
photoshoot.text: Calm sets, long patience, decisive frames.

editing.title: Editing
editing.text: A ruthless edit followed by colour work done by hand.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.text: A private gallery, print masters and archival files, delivered on time.

t1.quote: They photographed our wedding like it was a film we were lucky enough to star in. We have never seen ourselves this way.
t1.name: Layla & Omar

t2.quote: The campaign images outperformed every asset we have ever produced. Restraint, it turns out, sells.
t2.name: Nadia Rahal

t3.quote: Our building had been photographed a hundred times. This was the first time it looked the way it feels.
t3.name: Karim El-Sayed
